title: prunus fruticosa var. pendula
intro: Prunus fruticosa var. pendula, commonly known as Japanese weeping cherry, is a deciduous shrub or small tree with a distinctive weeping habit. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Prunus fruticosa var. pendula are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
